Giving this review after studying 1 months + experience. 
First of all, the environment here is very disturbing. If you are thinking of stopping and studying in the study room or Lab room u'll face a lot of trouble between 11-4 pm bcuz SSC+Bank student's both get collaborating.
If we talk about the faculty, all the teachers teach well but I have a little problem in maths because I'm not able to pick it up and there is only one faculty for each subject on both SSC and Bank segment. 
Reasoning, English even Mathematics teacher is fully supportive and approachable to solve the problem of solution of any chapter but I feel that 85% of my classmates or other Batchmates also want the faculty to hire another maths teacher as an option for students.
There are formalities in the name of Mock, everyone sits on offline mode for test & cheating aLot while test & then ranks are given on this basis.
I want to give you a personal advice, if you want to come here or any coaching then try to first study yourself because the teacher runs syllabus very quickly & a new student like me does not cover it at all Topics change in 2-3 maximum 4 classes, hence neither revision is done nor is there any way to understand anything, only 1-2% of the mains questions are conducted here.
Apart from the infrastructure and quality of books material The behaviour of teachers is very good, even that of the HOD, but according to me the HOD will have to be a little strict because the environment is really very disturbing. If you are studying by stopping then here .

GOVT Exam Wala

Subject: Formal Complaint Regarding Disrespectful Remarks Made in Class on 7th August

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am a student of the 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM batch at the Agra branch of your institute. I wish to bring to your attention an incident that occurred in class on 7th August, involving Bhuvensh Sir.

During the lecture, Sir made certain remarks which were disrespectful towards the Hindu religion and the Kanwar Yatra devotees (Kawadiyas). His comments included statements suggesting that Kawadiyas carry sticks solely to engage in violence, such as beating people or causing riots.

soppose example about a Kawadiya walking 95 km of a 100 km journey, and being touched by someone near the end, implying that the journey would be spoiled. He then questioned the logic of carrying sticks.
If Sir himself were ever to undertake the Kawad Yatra without carrying a stick for protection, and at the final moment his Kawad was spoiled due to someone?s intentional or unintentional act, would he be willing to start the entire journey again from the very beginning? This is the very reason many Kawadiyas carry sticks ? for the protection of their sacred Kawad during such a long and difficult journey.

Furthermore, Sir made remarks about respected religious figures Premanand Maharaj and Anurudacharya Ji, stating that they have ?opened a brand? and use expensive cars, in a manner that was mocking. These comments caused the entire class to laugh, which was highly disrespectful.

I would like to make it clear that Bhuvensh Sir teaches very well and is an excellent educator. I am not requesting his transfer or removal. However, I believe his views and way of expressing them should change. Respect for all religions and religious figures is important in a learning environment. Students attend this institute to gain knowledge, not to hear biased or mocking remarks about any faith.

Therefore, I request that the management kindly address this matter with him and ensure that he understands the importance of speaking on sensitive topics in a logical, respectful, and balanced manner. An apology from Sir to the class would also help in restoring the respectful environment.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
A Concerned Student
(8:00 AM ? 11:00 AM Batch, Agra Branch)

Subject: Request for Batch Change Due to Genuine Reasons

Respected Sir/Madam,

I would like to bring to your notice that due to my B.E. examinations and my father?s health issues, I was absent for around 50 days. Because of this, I have fallen behind in my syllabus and am facing difficulties in coping with the current batch.

Apart from my personal issues, the present batch environment is also troubling me, which is affecting my studies and making it difficult to concentrate.

When I approached the management to request a batch change, I was only given the option of the 5:00?8:00 PM batch, which is not possible for me as it would make me return home very late. Unfortunately, despite explaining my situation, no proper action has been taken so far.

Therefore, I sincerely request you to kindly allow me to shift to the 11:15 AM batch, as this timing is suitable for me and will help me cover my pending syllabus effectively in a better environment.

I hope you will consider my genuine reasons and help me continue my studies without further problems.

Thanking you,
[Niraj kumar ]
